## Adverse events

#### Read data and define subsets

All adverse events
```{r read_adverse_events_data}
de <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/adverse_events_derived.rds")
```

Serious adverse events
```{r}
de_ser <- de[investigator_alvorlighed == "Yes"]
```

10% most common adverse events based on MedDRA preferred term classification
```{r read_data}
(meddra_top10 <- de[, .N, by = meddra_pt][order(-N)][1:ceiling(.N * 0.1), meddra_pt])
de_top10 <- de[meddra_pt %in% meddra_top10]
```

Adverse events leading to premature discontinuation of treatment
```{r}
de_prem <- de[handling == "Yes"]
```

Severe, life-threatening and fatal adverse events
```{r}
de_severe <- de[gradering %in% c("Severe", "Life-threatening", "Fatal")]
```

Adverse events possibly or probably related to trail product
```{r}
de_rel <- de[investigator_relation == "Yes (possible, probable, certain)"]
```

Meta data
```{r}
tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
```


### Characteristics of adverse events 

Adverse events characterized by:

- Seriousness
- Severity
- Relationship to trial product
- Whether the event lead to premature treatment discontinuation
- Duration

Define footer list:
```{r}
ae_def <- paste(
  "Adverse events are any undesirable medical event occurring to a participant",
  "during a clinical trial, which does not necessarily have a causal relationship",
  "with the intervention. Adverse events were recorded from day 1 to day 10.", 
  "If events occurred, events were followed until they subsided or until", 
  "day 28 for the last included patient (last-patient, last-visit for day 28)."
  )

ser_def <- paste(
  "A serious adverse event is any adverse event that results in death,", 
  "is life-threatening, requires hospitalization or prolongation of existing",
  "hospitalization, results in persistent or significant disability or incapacity,",
  "or is a congenital anomaly or birth defect.")

severity_def <- paste(
  "Severity was graded using the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse", 
  "Events (CTCAE) scale.")

abbrev <- paste("N: Number of individuals.",
                 "%: Percentage of individuals in the safety analysis set.", 
                 "E: Number of events.")

footer_list_summary <- list(
  ae_def = ae_def,
  ser_def = ser_def,
  severity_def = severity_def,
  abbrev = abbrev
  )
```


#### Summary of all adverse events

Make summary of all AEs as gt table:
```{r mk_summary_table_all_events}
# Make summary of all AEs as dt object
ae_sum_dt_all <- mk_ae_dt(event_data = de)
# Make gt object version
ae_sum_gt_all <- mk_ae_gt(ae_sum_dt_all)
# Add footers to gt table
ae_sum_gt_all <- add_footer_lines_to_gt(ae_sum_gt_all, footer_list_summary)

# Display table
ae_sum_gt_all
```

Save gt table:
```{r}
save_gt_table(ae_sum_gt_all, 
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "all_adverse_events_summary"], 
              verbose = TRUE)
```

Make version of the same table for OVERVIEW-part of TLF-book:
```{r mk_summary_table_all_events_overview}
# Make footer with cross-ref to original table:
footer_present <- 
  paste0("Presentation is based on table: [-@sec-", 
         tlf_reg[file_stem == "all_adverse_events_summary", endpoint_id], "]")
footer_list_summary_overview <- 
  c(footer_list_summary, list(present = footer_present))

# Convert to gt and attach footers:
ae_sum_gt_all_ov <- mk_ae_gt(ae_sum_dt_all) |>
  add_footer_lines_to_gt(footer_list = footer_list_summary_overview)
ae_sum_gt_all_ov

# Save gt table:
save_gt_table(ae_sum_gt_all_ov,
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "all_adverse_events_summary_overview"],
              verbose = TRUE)
```

### Adverse events by MedDRA classification

Define footer list
```{r}
ae_def_meddra <- paste(
  "Adverse events are any undesirable medical event occurring to a participant",
  "during a clinical trial, which does not necessarily have a causal relationship",
  "with the intervention classified according to Medical Dictionary for Regulatory",
  "Activities (MedDRA, Version 29.0). Adverse events were recorded from day 1 to day 10.", 
  "If events occurred, events were followed until they subsided or until", 
  "day 28 for the last included patient (last-patient, last-visit for day 28)."
  )

top10_def <- paste("The most frequent adverse events were determined at the",
                   "preferred term level.")
    

footer_list_meddra <- list(
  ae_def_meddra = ae_def_meddra,
  abbrev = abbrev
  )

footer_list_meddra_ser <- list(
  ae_def_meddra = ae_def_meddra,
  ser_def = ser_def,
  abbrev = abbrev
  )

footer_list_meddra_severe <- list(
  ae_def_meddra = ae_def_meddra,
  severity_def = severity_def,
  abbrev = abbrev
  )

footer_list_meddra_top10 <- list(
  ae_def_meddra = ae_def_meddra,
  top10_def = top10_def,
  abbrev = abbrev
  )
```

### Line listings 


#### Line listings of serious adverse events

Add baseline data with data on SAEs, select columns and format data:
```{r}
# Get baseline information
dbl <- readRDS(file="02_data_derived/baselinedata.rds")

# Merge SAE and baseline data
ll_ser <- merge(de_ser, dbl[, .(ID, c_sex, n_age)], by = "ID")

# Add identifier for SAE
ll_ser[, SAE := paste0("#", .I)]

# Format investigator_relation levels
stopifnot(ll_ser[, levels(investigator_relation)] %in% 
            c("Yes (possible, probable, certain)", "No (none, unlikely)"))
ll_ser[, investigator_relation := ifelse(
  investigator_relation == "Yes (possible, probable, certain)", "Yes", "No")]

# Select columns
ll_ser <- ll_ser[, .(SAE, n_age, c_sex,trt, meddra_pt, sae_kriterie,
                     investigator_relation)]

# Format variables
ll_ser[, n_age := round(as.numeric(n_age))]
ll_ser[, c_sex := substr(c_sex,1,1)]

# Ensure the SAE identifier maps to the correct SAE, using age (which is unique)
# as the matching key
stopifnot(nrow(ll_ser) == 4,
          nrow(ll_ser[SAE == "#1" & n_age == 25]) == 1,
          nrow(ll_ser[SAE == "#2" & n_age == 33]) == 1,
          nrow(ll_ser[SAE == "#3" & n_age == 40]) == 1,
          nrow(ll_ser[SAE == "#4" & n_age == 22]) == 1)
```

Specify SAE criteria and add description based on clinical notes:
```{r}
# SAE #1
ll_ser[SAE == "#1", `:=` (c_sex = "M-F",
                          sae_kriterie = "Hospitalization",
                          Description = paste("Non-trial staff from the out-patient",
                          "clinic at which the participant receives treatment conclude",
                          "that the participant is at increased risk of suicide and", 
                          "offers admission to a psychiatric ward, which the participant",
                          "accepts. Trial product is not discontinued, as the participant",
                          "wish to proceed with the intervention. At day 7 of the trial",
                          "(last day of intervention) the participant reports habitual",
                          "suicidal thoughts at baseline level.")
                          ) ]

# SAE #2
ll_ser[SAE == "#2", `:=` (sae_kriterie = "Significant medical event, Foetal malformation",
                          Description = paste("The participant conceives during the",
                          "intervention phase of the trial. At inclusion, the participant",
                          "received written information about the need for anticontraceptive",
                          "measures, reported being on an oral anticontraceptive and had a",
                          "negative human chorionic gonadotropin test. At gestational age",
                          "20+6, foetal malformation is found on ultrasound. Abortion. At",
                          "the time of conception, the participant was treated with",
                          "several medications in addition to the trial product, including",
                          "a tricyclic antidepressant with known teratogenicity.")
                          )]

#SAE #3
ll_ser[SAE == "#3", `:=` (sae_kriterie = "Hospitalization",
                          Description = paste("The participant is hospitalized on the",
                          "last day of the trial intervention for a planned course of",
                          "electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) due to treatment-refractory",
                          "depression at the discretion of a non-trial medical doctor.",
                          "Depression scores at baseline and time of admission are similar.")
                          )]

# SAE #4
ll_ser[SAE == "#4", `:=` (sae_kriterie = "Prolonged hospitalization",
                          Description = paste("During admission, the participant reports",
                          "increased restlessness and agitation as well as thoughts of",
                          "his own death to non-trial staff. Denies that the thoughts are",
                          "suicidal or have characteristics of hallucinations. On day 5 of",
                          "the intervention, non-trial staff decides to discontinue the",
                          "trial product and prolong the participants hospitalization due",
                          "to agitation and suspected psychosis. On the day 7 of the trial,",
                          "a trial investigator finds no psychotic or manic symptoms present,",
                          "in accordance with later evaluations by non-trial staff at the",
                          "ward.")
                          )]
```

Format data and make gt table object:
```{r}
# Format column names
setnames(ll_ser, 
         c("n_age", "c_sex","trt","meddra_pt","sae_kriterie", "investigator_relation"),
         c("Age","Sex","Treatment","MedDRA Preferred Term", "SAE Criteria", "Relationship*"))

# Make gt version of SAE line listings 
ll_ser_gt <- gt(ll_ser) |> set_gt_style() |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(v_align = "top"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = everything())
  )
```

Add footers:
```{r}
meddra_def <- paste("Adverse events are classified according to Medical Dictionary",
                    "for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA, Version 29.0).")
rel_def <- paste("\\* “Yes” is defined as a possible, probably or likely relationship",
                 "between trial product and adverse event. “No” is defined as none", 
                 "or an unlikely relationship.")

ll_ser_footer <- list(
  ser_def = ser_def,
  meddra_def = meddra_def,
  rel_def = rel_def,
  abbrev = paste("M-F: Male to female transition.",
                 "SAE: Serious adverse event")
  )

# Add footers to SAE table
ll_ser_gt <- add_footer_lines_to_gt(ll_ser_gt, ll_ser_footer)
ll_ser_gt
```

Save table:
```{r}
save_gt_table(ll_ser_gt, 
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "line_listing_SAE"], 
              verbose = TRUE)
```


#### Line listings of adverse events leading to premature treatment discontinuation

Add baseline data with data on AE leading to premature treatment discontinuation,
select columns and format data:
```{r}
ll_aepm <- merge(de_prem, dbl[, .(ID, c_sex, n_age)], by = "ID")

# Format age and sex variables
ll_aepm[, n_age := round(as.numeric(n_age))]
ll_aepm[, c_sex := substr(c_sex,1,1)]

# Format investigator_relation levels
stopifnot(ll_aepm[, levels(investigator_relation)] %in% c("Yes (possible, probable, certain)", 
                                                          "No (none, unlikely)"))
ll_aepm[, investigator_relation := ifelse(investigator_relation == "Yes (possible, probable, certain)", "Yes", "No")]

# Add AE-PM identifier
ll_aepm[, `AE-PM` := paste0("#", .I)]

# Select columns
ll_aepm <- ll_aepm[, .(`AE-PM`, n_age, c_sex, trt, meddra_pt, 
                       investigator_relation)]

# Ensure the AE-PM identifier maps to the correct AE-PM, using age (which is unique)
# as the matching key
stopifnot(nrow(ll_aepm) == 3,
          nrow(ll_aepm[`AE-PM` == "#1" & n_age == 27]) == 1,
          nrow(ll_aepm[`AE-PM` == "#2" & n_age == 22]) == 1,
          nrow(ll_aepm[`AE-PM` == "#3" & n_age == 54]) == 1)

```

Add descriptions based on clinical notes:
```{r}
# AE-PM #1
ll_aepm[`AE-PM` == "#1", `:=` (`Discontinued by` = "Medical doctor (investigator)",
                               Description = paste("The participant reports discoloration",
                               "of urine and three days of muscle soreness in proximal",
                               "limbs and general unease. The trial product is discontinued",
                               "due to suspension of myopathy on day 6. The day after",
                               "discontinuation, blood tests were done. Creatine kinase,",
                               "myoglobin, lactate dehydrogenase and aspartate aminotransferase",
                               "were all within normal range and myopathy was ruled out.")
                               )]

# AE-PM #2
ll_aepm[`AE-PM` == "#2", `:=` (`Discontinued by` = "Medical doctor (non-trial staff)",
                               Description = paste("The trial product was discontinued on day",
                               "5 of the intervention by a medical doctor at the in-patient",
                               "ward to which the participant was admitted. Corresponds to",
                               "SAE #4 (see “Details on Serious Adverse Events“)")
                               )]

# AE-PM #3
ll_aepm[`AE-PM` == "#3", `:=` (`Discontinued by` = "Participant",
                               Description = paste("After ingestion of the first two",
                               "doses of the trial product, the participant reports",
                               "increased irritability that results in an argument with",
                               "a close family member. The participant classifies this",
                               "behaviour as abnormal compared to her normal mental state.",
                               "Decides to discontinue the trial product.")
                               )]
```

Format and make gt table object:
```{r}
# Format column names
setnames(ll_aepm, 
         c("n_age", "c_sex","trt","meddra_pt", "investigator_relation"),
         c("Age","Sex","Treatment","MedDRA Preferred Term", "Relationship*"))

# Make gt version of AE-PM table
ll_aepm_gt <- gt(ll_aepm) |> set_gt_style() |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(v_align = "top"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = everything())
  )
```

Add footers:
```{r}
# Specify table footers
ll_aepm_footer <- list(  
  meddra_def = meddra_def,
  rel_def = rel_def,
  abbrev = "AE-PM: Adverse event leading to premature discontinuation of trial product")

# Add footers to gt table
ll_aepm_gt <- add_footer_lines_to_gt(ll_aepm_gt, ll_aepm_footer)
ll_aepm_gt
```

Save gt table:
```{r}
save_gt_table(ll_aepm_gt, 
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "line_listing_premature_discontinuation"], 
              verbose = TRUE)
```


## Admissions, suicide attempts and deaths

Read data
```{r}
dads <- readRDS("02_data_derived/admissions_deaths_suicides_derived.rds")
```

Define footer list
```{r}
footer_list_admissions <- list(
  scale = paste(
  "A psychiatric emergency department visit followed by admission",
  "is counted as two separate events. Suicide attempts are defined as non-fatal."),
  abbrev = abbrev
  )
```


#### Summary of admissions, suicide attempts and deaths by day 28

```{r admissions_day28}
# Make serious clinical events data.table
adm_dt28 <- mk_outcome_dt(outcome_data = dads, day28 = TRUE)

# Save data.table object
saveRDS(adm_dt28, "50_output_db/outputs/serious_clinical_events_day28.rds")

# Convert to gt and attach footers
adm_gt28 <- mk_ae_gt(adm_dt28)
adm_gt28 <- add_footer_lines_to_gt(adm_gt28, footer_list_admissions)
adm_gt28

# Save gt table
save_gt_table(adm_gt28, 
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "serious_clinical_events"], 
              verbose = TRUE)
```

Make version of the same table for OVERVIEW-part of TLF-book:
```{r admissions_day28_overview}
# Make footer with cross-ref to original table:
footer_present <- 
  paste0("Presentation is based on table: [-@sec-", 
         tlf_reg[file_stem == "serious_clinical_events", endpoint_id], "]")
footer_list_admissions_overview <- 
  c(footer_list_admissions, list(present = footer_present))

# Convert to gt and attach footers:
adm_gt28_ov <- mk_ae_gt(adm_dt28) |>
  add_footer_lines_to_gt(footer_list = footer_list_admissions_overview)
adm_gt28_ov

# Save gt table:
save_gt_table(adm_gt28_ov,
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "serious_clinical_events_overview"],
              verbose = TRUE)
```
